ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about how Allah sends down rain?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Muddaththir, this verse serves as a potent sign (ayah) of Allah's absolute power over creation, often cited by Shia exegetes to illustrate the certainty of the Resurrection through the analogy of rain reviving dead land. The term 'sabban' implies a deliberate, abundant pouring, emphasizing that just as water brings life to barren earth, divine will can resurrect the dead, reinforcing the core theological message of the chapter.
